kind: Read-only source review; no compilation, measurement or product change.
conclusion: The PagedRead liveness exclusion is a private batch boundary, not a confirmed currently reachable ordinary multi-node arena defect. No existing public/Graph construction path was found that compiles a multi-node PagedRead recipe.

actual_paths.fact: The sole PagedRead construction builds one request-local Recipe with exactly one node and three external Q/K/V inputs.
The private operation borrows the native batch slot immutable topology; it is not exposed by the ordinary public operation factory.
Ordinary Graph native region admission first requires region_operation.
region_operation includes ordinary SDPA and CacheEncode but excludes private PagedRead.
Ordinary Direct prepare also creates a single-node recipe.

necessary_boundaries.fact: Paged topology is an external I32 src5 leaf borrowing actual layout data. Q1 updates can replace its pointer and shape/strides plus logical KV rows.
The contiguous Q1 ragged update mutates real external K/V root and view extents/strides, while immutable query/output remain fixed.

Request.compiled_layout and Slot.layout retain the owning immutable versions. Equal non-Q1 paged recipes keep their original compiled-layout owner; Q1 refreshes pointers before replacing the current owner.

Q8 attention records the original dense query and validates it before graph execution. Current batch Q is an external input. A future multi-node producer of Q would require an explicit checked execution boundary; merely removing the allocator exclusion would read an uncomputed/reused internal tensor. Old arena allocation does not solve that semantic issue.
The original flash workspace plan is based on DK/DV/query-heads/thread count and fixed tile maxima, not the current KV row count. Existing Q1 metadata refresh relies on this finite contract.
Official gallocr recognizes a non-null data pointer as externally owned. Thus a borrowed page table is not intrinsically incompatible with gallocr; its current identity/lifetime must remain external.

minimal_recommendation: Keep the current private dynamic boundary. Removing the multi-node PagedRead exclusion has no current ordinary-graph benefit. If a real future multi-node entry is introduced, first restrict it to immutable topology and external checked Q8 query, then reuse GraphStorage; do not invent an allocator/planner or claim all dynamic descriptions are safe after one reserve.
complexity_scope: No currently reachable multi-node PagedRead chain retaining Theta(N * payload) was established. Current requests have fixed native graph depth; per-request query conversion, output and native plan scratch remain distinct from a deep ordinary chain.
